steps.title: 检查磁盘空间
steps.hint: 建议预留 ≥65GB（Diffusers + 官方权重约 53GB）。空间不够判 low_disk，停在这一步。

music3.disk.low_space.zh: 磁盘剩余约 {free}GB，低于建议的 {want}GB（官方权重约 53GB）。清理磁盘或换一个剩余空间足够的安装目录后重跑，或用 -Force 跳过本闸门。
music3.disk.low_space.en: the disk has about {free}GB free, below the suggested {want}GB (the official weights are about 53GB). Free up space or pick a different install directory and re-run, or pass -Force to skip this gate.

music3.disk.unreadable.zh: 无法读取安装目录所在磁盘的剩余空间：{err}。
music3.disk.unreadable.en: cannot read the free space of the drive holding the install directory: {err}.

steps.title: 建立 venv 并安装 CUDA torch
steps.hint: 先体检显卡 / 驱动，再自动取一个 Python 3.11 / 3.12 当基座（本机没有就自己下，不用你装），在**隔离** venv 里装 CUDA torch（不再沿用系统 torch）；torch 档位不对会在这一步报错。

music3.torch.cuda_unavailable.zh: torch 装上了但 cuda.is_available() 为 false：装的是 CPU 版 torch，或本机 NVIDIA 驱动不支持所装 CUDA 档位（本版要 cu130 = CUDA 13.0，驱动主版本需 ≥ 580）。升级驱动后重跑本步；日志里 torch 的版本号会写明装的是哪一档。原始探针输出：{probe}
music3.torch.cuda_unavailable.en: torch is installed but cuda.is_available() is false: either the CPU build got installed, or the local NVIDIA driver does not support the CUDA tier that was installed (this build wants cu130 = CUDA 13.0, driver major >= 580). Upgrade the driver and re-run this step; the torch version in the log names the tier. Raw probe output: {probe}

music3.gpu.none.zh: 没检测到可用的 NVIDIA 显卡：Music3 本地后端在 CPU 上跑不出结果。请换一台有 N 卡的机器再装；若本来就想在这台机器上跑，先装好 NVIDIA 驱动并确认命令行能执行 nvidia-smi。
music3.gpu.none.en: no usable NVIDIA GPU was detected: the local Music3 backend cannot produce results on CPU. Install on a machine with an NVIDIA card, or get nvidia-smi working from the command line first. Diagnostic tail: {tail}

music3.gpu.driver_old.zh: 显卡在，但 NVIDIA 驱动太旧（本版要 cu130 = CUDA 13.0，驱动主版本需 ≥ 580）：装上也跑不起来。请把驱动升级到 580 或更高后重跑。诊断日志尾部：{tail}
music3.gpu.driver_old.en: the GPU is there but the NVIDIA driver is too old (this build wants cu130 = CUDA 13.0, driver major >= 580), so it would not run. Upgrade the driver to 580+ and re-run. Diagnostic tail: {tail}

music3.python.missing.zh: 这台机器上找不到可用的 Python 3.11 / 3.12，脚本自己下载一个也没成功（走 npmmirror 的 python-build-standalone）。多半是网络问题或目录不可写：确认能访问 registry.npmmirror.com 后重跑本步；也可以自己装一个 Python 3.11（python.org 或 Microsoft Store）后重跑，或设环境变量 MT_MUSIC_CUDA_PYTHON 指向已有解释器。诊断日志尾部：{tail}
music3.python.missing.en: no usable Python 3.11 / 3.12 was found and fetching one failed too (python-build-standalone via npmmirror). Usually network or a non-writable cache: make sure registry.npmmirror.com is reachable and re-run; or install Python 3.11 yourself (python.org / Microsoft Store), or point MT_MUSIC_CUDA_PYTHON at an existing interpreter. Diagnostic tail: {tail}

music3.python.fetch_failed.zh: 取基座 Python 这一步失败了（下载或解压没成功）。网络可达后重跑本步即可（已下载的解释器会复用，不会重复下）。诊断日志尾部：{tail}
music3.python.fetch_failed.en: fetching the base Python failed (download / extraction). Re-run this step once the network is fine - an already fetched interpreter is reused. Diagnostic tail: {tail}

music3.python.too_old.zh: 你指定的 Python 太旧：torch 2.9.1+cu130 只提供 cp311 及以上的轮子（3.11 / 3.12 为宜）。换一个解释器，或清掉 MT_MUSIC_CUDA_PYTHON / -CudaPython 让脚本自己取。诊断日志尾部：{tail}
music3.python.too_old.en: the interpreter you pointed at is too old: torch 2.9.1+cu130 only ships cp311+ wheels (3.11 / 3.12 preferred). Use another interpreter, or clear MT_MUSIC_CUDA_PYTHON / -CudaPython and let the script fetch one. Diagnostic tail: {tail}

music3.python.too_new.zh: 你指定的 Python 太新：torch 2.9.1+cu130 的轮子只覆盖到 cp313。换一个 3.11 / 3.12 的解释器，或清掉 MT_MUSIC_CUDA_PYTHON / -CudaPython 让脚本自己取。诊断日志尾部：{tail}
music3.python.too_new.en: the interpreter you pointed at is too new: the torch 2.9.1+cu130 wheels only go up to cp313. Use a 3.11 / 3.12 interpreter, or clear MT_MUSIC_CUDA_PYTHON / -CudaPython and let the script fetch one. Diagnostic tail: {tail}

steps.title: 安装推理依赖（diffusers 固定 commit）
steps.hint: diffusers 依赖来自 GitHub：直连失败会走 ghproxy 镜像。

music3.deps.prep_failed.zh: 环境准备失败：{err}。pip 已依次试过清华 / 阿里云 / USTC / 官方 PyPI，requirements 里的 diffusers 还会再走 GitHub + ghproxy 镜像 —— 若日志里是「No matching distribution found for 某包」，就是该包在四个源上都没同步、按包名上报；否则看本步日志尾部的原始报错后重跑。
music3.deps.prep_failed.en: environment prep failed: {err}. pip already tried Tsinghua / Aliyun / USTC / official PyPI in order, and the diffusers entry in requirements walks GitHub + the ghproxy mirror too - if the log says 'No matching distribution found for <package>', that package is not synced on those four mirrors (report the package name); otherwise read the raw error in this step's log tail and re-run.

steps.title: 下载官方权重
steps.hint: ModelScope 优先，失败回退 hf-mirror；权重约 53GB，断点续传。

music3.weights.download_failed.zh: 权重下载失败：{err}。App 权重走 hf-mirror，Comfy 权重走 ModelScope；确认网络后重跑，已完成分片会复用。
music3.weights.download_failed.en: weight download failed: {err}. The app weights come from hf-mirror and the Comfy weights from ModelScope; make sure the network reaches them and re-run - finished shards are reused.

music3.files.incomplete.zh: 权重文件不完整：{err}。重跑 scripts\download_models.ps1 -Target app 补齐（支持续传）。
music3.files.incomplete.en: the weight files are incomplete: {err}. Re-run scripts\download_models.ps1 -Target app to fill the gaps (it resumes).

steps.title: 冒烟：导入并写安装标记

music3.smoke.import_failed.zh: 冒烟导入失败：{err}。依赖装了一半或版本冲突，看这一步日志后重跑安装。
music3.smoke.import_failed.en: the smoke import failed: {err}. Dependencies are half installed or version-conflicted; read this step's log and re-run the install.
